def safe_index(xs, i):
    """ 
    PRECONDITION: len(xs) > 0 and 0 <= i < len(xs)
    POSTCONDITION: 0 <= result < len(xs) and xs[result] == xs[i]
    """
    return i

def safe_factorial_base_case(n):
    """
    PRECONDITION: n >= 0
    POSTCONDITION: result == 1
    """
    return 1

def safe_slice_end(n):
    """
    PRECONDITION: n >= 0
    POSTCONDITION: result >= 0 and result == n - 1
    """
    return n - 1

def first_n(xs, n):
    return xs[:n]
